ios.desc:
Turn Your Notes into Quizzes Instantly with Grape

Supercharge your study game with Grape - the smart quiz creator that transforms your handwritten notes or screenshots into engaging quizzes in just seconds.

How Does Grape Work?

It’s simple!
• Snap a photo of your notes or take a screenshot.
• Convert the content to text automatically using Grape’s powerful recognition technology.
• Quiz yourself with interactive formats designed to make learning faster, more enjoyable, and highly effective.

No more tedious manual reviews - Grape helps you focus on what matters: mastering your content with ease.


Why Choose Grape?
• Photo to Quiz Power
Capture your handwritten notes or printed materials, and Grape’s intelligent quiz creator instantly turns them into fun, interactive quizzes. Perfect for visual learners and those who love trivia-style study methods.

• Anki-Inspired Edge
If you’re a fan of Anki flashcards, Grape takes it to the next level. Convert your notes into picture-based trivia quizzes that reinforce active recall - one of the most effective memory techniques proven to improve long-term retention.

• Spaced Repetition for Better Memory
Grape uses smart quiz scheduling to help you revisit key information at optimal intervals - maximizing your study efficiency and ensuring you remember what matters most.

• Study Your Way
Tailor your quiz experience with flexible options like:
	- Multiple-choice questions
	- Manual input for precise practice
	- Customizable formats to suit your learning preferences

• Effortless & Smart
Our advanced AI handles the heavy lifting - from recognizing handwriting to generating quiz questions - so you can focus entirely on learning.

• Share Your Quiz
Turn learning into a collaborative experience! Once you’ve created a quiz, easily share it with friends, classmates, or study groups. Whether you’re preparing for a group project, tutoring someone, or challenging friends to a knowledge showdown, Grape makes it simple and fun.

• Minimalist Design, Without Distraction
A clean, clutter-free interface keeps your focus on what matters - learning.


Key Features & Use Cases

• Snap & Convert Notes into Quizzes
Example: Take a photo of your handwritten biology notes, and Grape instantly creates a quiz to test your understanding of key concepts.

• Generate Quizzes from Extracted Text
Example: Screenshot a Google Translate result or online study material and convert it into an interactive quiz - perfect for language learners!
